scientific_integrity: Exact finite identities are proved by tree classification and order-statistic densities. Limit statements are justified analytically; computational tests are finite diagnostics, not substitutes for proofs.
scientific_limitations: Canonical K_(2,q) edge-indicator geometry and i.i.d. Gaussian objectives only. Gaussian maxima asymptotics are classical; an unindexed equivalent marked-tree theorem remains possible.
title: A Gaussian–Gumbel–exponential bridge law for two-hub spanning-tree polytopes
